answer: Trust random walks. Each epoch validators launch 12-hop random walks from 50 veteran seeds over the graph of paid, completed jobs; a seat's vote weight is its landing probability. A sybil nebula can mint endless keys, but walks only enter it via the few real trade edges it buys, so its weight is capped by edge count, not key count. One edge costs ~200 POA of genuine paid work, so 1,000 fakes behind 10 edges get about 10 seats' weight. Dense-inside, thin-outside clusters sink to the nadir; stable seats earn an opal badge.
